claim: does the closed-loop PLL (design/top/top.sch -- VCO + PFD/charge pump + loop filter + divider, issue #28), driven from a cold start (RESETB power-on, VCTRL starting at whatever the loop filter's own initial condition is) with a 1 MHz reference (spec/target-spec.md row 3's DRAFT low band edge), lock its output to N * Fref = 64 * 1 MHz = 64 MHz within this manifest's transient window -- issue #55's sibling of sim/pll-lock's own 10 MHz-reference campaign, exercising row 3's frequency-range claim at more than the single 10 MHz point sim/pll-lock/testbench/tb_pll_lock.sch drives. This is a design-input record, not a spec claim: row 3 is DRAFT/unratified, and per this testbench's own header comment (tb_pll_lock_1mhz.sch), N=64 is the divider's maximum representable ratio, chosen because it is the closest achievable target to sim/vco/records/20260819-131741-fe0e6df.md's characterized VCO tuning floor (~145.1 MHz) -- 64 MHz is still below that floor, so this record is expected to surface a distinct design fact (a 1 MHz reference cannot be strapped to land the closed-loop target inside the currently-characterized VCO range at all, given the divider's N<=64 ceiling), not necessarily a lock.
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/top/top.sch, the real four-block closed-loop PLL (not a throwaway circuit) -- straps NSEL[5:0]=111111 (N=64, the divider's maximum representable ratio) and drives REF with a 1 MHz clock and RESETB with the same power-on reset pwl sim/pll-lock/testbench/tb_pll_lock.sch uses. `require_lock` is false, for the same reason sim/pll-lock's own manifest gives (a point that completes but never locks is recorded as evidence, not a harness failure) -- here compounded by N=64*1 MHz=64 MHz sitting below sim/vco's characterized tuning floor (~145.1 MHz at VCTRL=0.8V; VCTRL<0.8V is not characterized and this testbench does not extrapolate past it per issue #55/CLAUDE.md), so a lock at this exact target is not expected to be achievable with the current VCO/divider combination -- that is itself the row-3-low-band-edge evidence this campaign exists to produce. A gated pass/fail, and any resulting spec/design decision, is deferred to a future ratifying DR once this record and sim/pll-lock's own are both available to argue from.
